description:
RimSort is an open source mod manager for the video game RimWorld. There is support for Linux, Mac, and Windows, built from the ground up to be a reliable, community-managed alternative to RimPy Mod Manager.


Stable release v1.12.0.
The latest commit is 51646ef40891b37f7d79aa2aaa2f47a878dfbc47.

Refer to the [action run](https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/actions/runs/32755111688) that created this release.
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 51646ef40891b37f7d79aa2aaa2f47a878dfbc47 -->

## What's Changed
### 🚀 Features and Improvements
• feat(macOS)：support Apple Silicon build standardization & add Append Mod List feature by @qennenat in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2361
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
• Fix symlink test to use junction on Windows by @LionelColaso in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2390
### 🔧 Maintenance and Internal Changes
• Disable BLE001 and strip inline noqa comments project-wide by @LionelColaso in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2388
• Introduce cov_opts and update test comment by @LionelColaso in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2389
### Miscellaneous Changes
• build(deps)：bump charset-normalizer from 3.5.0 to 3.5.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2381
• build(deps)：bump github/codeql-action from 4.37.7 to 4.37.8 in /.github/workflows by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2384
• build(deps)：bump lxml from 6.1.1 to 6.1.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2387
• build(deps-dev)：bump types-pygments from 2.20.0.20260728 to 2.21.0.20260819 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2386
• build(deps-dev)：bump ruff from 0.16.3 to 0.16.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2385
• update translations by @LionelColaso in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2391
